content: First, you need to train your model and extract feature importances. You can use libraries like scikit-learn for this. For tree-based models, feature importances are directly available via the `feature_importances_` attribute. For models without built-in feature importance, you can use permutation importance or SHAP values. Next, use a bar chart to visualize the feature importances. You can use matplotlib or seaborn for plotting. Create the bar chart with feature names on the x-axis and importance scores on the y-axis. Sort the features by importance for better readability. Add a title, axis labels, and a legend if necessary. Finally, display the plot.
